title.zh: Gamdom遭勒索组织Whitearmor索要1500万美元比特币赎金
title.en: Gamdom遭勒索组织Whitearmor索要1500万美元比特币赎金

current_state.zh: Ransomware group Whitearmor claims to possess a 15.4 million-account Gamdom customer database and is demanding $15 million in bitcoin to prevent its publication.

updates.title_en: Gamdom遭勒索组织Whitearmor索要1500万美元比特币赎金
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 27 日报道，网络勒索组织 Whitearmor 声称掌握包含 15,420,003 个 Gamdom 客户账户的数据库，并要求支付价值 1500 万美元的比特币以阻止数据被公开。该组织在其勒索网站上公布了 Gamdom 的相关信息，并发布了一份约 437 KB、包含约 100 条记录的 JSON 样本文件作为证据，声称可访问每个账户的 146 个数据字段。

若该说法属实，涉及的是一个加密货币博彩平台上超过 1500 万个账户的用户数据，但这一说法目前仅来自勒索组织自身。此次勒索发生在 Gamdom 尚未从早前数百万美元热钱包被盗事件中完全恢复之际。

据报道，攻击者据称通过一台老旧的内部机器账户实施入侵，该账户凭证从未轮换更新，尽管创建已久仍保留管理员权限。1540 万账户这一数字及样本文件均来自 Whitearmor 单方面说法，尚未获得独立核实。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Ransomware group Whitearmor claims to possess a 15.4 million-account Gamdom customer database and is demanding $15 million in bitcoin to prevent its publication.
updates.background_zh: 据 bitcoin.com 的评测，Gamdom 是一家自 2016 年起运营的加密货币赌场与体育博彩平台，由哥斯达黎加的 Moon Revolution Limitada 运营。据 Breachsense、SOCRadar 和 TheHackerWire 发布的档案，Whitearmor 是近期出现的勒索组织，目前记录在案的受害者仅有少数几个。安全研究者指出，从未轮换的过期机器凭证是攻击者常用且持久的入侵入口。
updates.background_en: Gamdom is a crypto casino and sportsbook that has operated since 2016, run by Costa Rica-based Moon Revolution Limitada, according to a bitcoin.com review. Whitearmor is a recently emerged ransomware group tracked with only a handful of named victims so far, according to profiles published by Breachsense, SOCRadar and TheHackerWire. Security researchers note that stale machine credentials that are never rotated are a common and durable entry point for attackers.
updates.market_impact_zh: 直接传导渠道是用户数据风险与平台信任，而非代币供给：加密货币博彩网站账户数据若外泄，可能被用于针对关联钱包与交易所账户的撞库和钓鱼攻击。影响主要集中在 Gamdom 自身用户群以及加密博彩平台的运维安全实践层面，而非系统性市场基础设施。
updates.market_impact_en: The immediate transmission channel is user-data risk and platform trust rather than token supply: leaked account records from a crypto gambling site could feed credential-stuffing and phishing against linked wallets and exchange accounts. Exposure is concentrated in Gamdom's own user base and in the operational-security practices of crypto gambling venues, not in a systemic market venue.
